channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemeni diplomat says Houthis want to drag Saudi Arabia into war
item.description: Houthis are trying to drag Saudi Arabia into conflict by targeting Saudi territory, says Yemen’s Ambassador to Qatar.

item.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia could activate defence pact, Pakistan says
item.description: Pakistan warns Mecca defence agreement may be activated if Yemen's Houthi rebels continue targeting Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Bangladesh measles deaths surpass 1,000 after vaccination drive falls short
item.description: Bangladesh faces its worst measles outbreak, killing 1,002 children and infecting nearly 190,000 since March.

item.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
item.description: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

item.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
item.description: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

item.title: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
item.description: Five deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes.

item.title: Family of killed teen call for death penalty in D4vd trial
item.description: The parents of Celeste Rivas Hernandez say execution "would be perfect" if D4vd is found guilty.

item.title: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
item.description: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.

item.title: Where is Israel's proposed West Bank settlement the UK opposes?
item.description: BBC's Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports from an area close to Israel's proposed site in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Pupils return to West Bank school behind barbed wire to protect against settlers
item.description: Six people, including three pupils at the Palestinian school, have been killed in al-Mughayyir this year, in a surge of Israeli settler-related violence.
